notes.text: SALARY TABLES: the 1 April 2016 values from art. 152 c.1 of the renewal of 18 January 2014 (p. 17); the five tranches lug 2024, giu 2025, mag 2026, apr 2027 and nov 2027 from art. 152 c.1 of the ipotesi of 5 July 2024 (p. 42).

APPRENTICESHIP: 80%, 85%, 90% and 95% from the fourth year (art. 58 c.1, 2010 text p. 90), to which art. 152 c.4 of the 2024 text still refers. Destination levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 6s and 6. The durations of art. 54 of the 2010 text were replaced by the accordo apprendistato of 17 April 2012 and its art. 14 bis (renewal of 18 January 2014, p. 12: 2 and 3 34 months, 6 22 months with prior learning); no signed copy of the 2012 accord was found, so its base durations are not sourced. The 95% band is open-ended.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 172 for the 40-hour week (art. 151 c.1, 2010 text p. 135); 190 and 192 for 44 and 45 hours not modelled.
MONTHLY PAYMENTS: 14, art. 160 (tredicesima) and art. 161 (quattordicesima, paid with the July pay) as replaced by the renewal of 5 July 2024 (pp. 45-46).
SENIORITY: six scatti triennali (art. 158, 2010 text pp. 140-141), fixed amounts per level from 1 May 1990.
CNEL code H052 is shared with CCNL Agenzie di Viaggio Fiavet: the engine allows duplicates.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: art. 158 c.1 (2010 text, p. 140) grants the six scatti 'a tutto il personale' and art. 58 pays the apprentice a percentage of the normale retribuzione of the qualified worker, which art. 148 defines with the scatti: apprentices accrue the level amount. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship; the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: SICKNESS (art. 228, 2010 text p. 184): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay without saying how the net pay is computed; the engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate, as for the Commercio file. Day 1 of the carenza is the worker's when the illness lasts three days or less (c.5): the engine pays all three days. For fixed-term and seasonal workers no integration is due past the end of the contract (c.2).

limitation.remediation: Model the net daily pay of art. 228, the unpaid first day of a short illness and the end of a fixed-term contract.

notes.text: Art. 152 c. 2 as replaced in 2024, p. 43: the lower paga base of 1-2 star hotels and campsites up to 1200 presenze (level 4 1,688.98 instead of 1,695.69 from May 2026).

limitation.remediation: Add an employer fact for the small-hotel table.

notes.text: Art. 13 c. 10, pp. 11-12: the elemento economico di garanzia paid with the November 2027 pay without an integrative agreement by 31 October 2026 (A and B 186, 1-3 158, 4-5 140, 6s-7 112).

limitation.remediation: Model the 2027 guarantee element as a conditional allowance.

notes.text: Art. 155 c. 3, p. 44: the hourly table of the extra workers.
Art. 145: the absorption of the Quadri allowance into individual treatments.
Art. 158 c. 2-3: the first scatto counted from age 18 and from the month after the triennium.

limitation.remediation: Count the first scatto from age 18.

notes.text: Art. 58 c. 3: the net cap of the apprentice pay.
Artt. 160 c. 4 and 161 c. 6: the ratei of the tredicesima and quattordicesima during maternity, paternity and parental leave.

limitation.remediation: Accrue the ratei during the leaves.

notes.text: Verbale of 30 November 2016: the lower ramp of the hires of 14 November 2016. The caller pays these amounts as variable items.

APPRENTICESHIP DURATIONS: the durations of the professionalizzante come from the accord of 17 April 2012 as amended in 2014, of which no signed or CNEL copy was found (only aggregator copies); the percentages of art. 58 are verified. Every apprentice run carries this limitation.

limitation.remediation: Read a signed copy of the accord of 17 April 2012 and its 2014 amendment.

notes.text: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-20, Gazzetta Ufficiale text, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticolo?art.codiceRedazionale=26A00149&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-01-21&art.flagTipoArticolo=0&art.idArticolo=1&art.idGruppo=1&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.progressivo=1&art.versione=1, page sha256 e05f6f864509f87e7488cdae075fe3a1f2632f6f4577b87ee05479a1ed193c1d): from 1 January to 30 September 2026 the workers of the esercizi di somministrazione di alimenti e bevande (L. 287/1991 art. 5) and of the 'comparto del turismo, ivi inclusi gli stabilimenti termali', with employment income of 2025 not above 40,000 EUR, receive 'un trattamento integrativo speciale, che non concorre alla formazione del reddito, pari al 15 per cento delle retribuzioni lorde corrisposte in relazione al lavoro notturno e alle prestazioni di lavoro straordinario [...] effettuate nei giorni festivi'. The employer pays it 'su richiesta del lavoratore' (c. 20), a fact the request has no field for: the engine does not pay it, so the net pay of a worker who asked for it is understated.

limitation.remediation: Add the worker's request of c. 20 to the request, pay 15% of the night and holiday overtime pay of the run as a credit, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule read again in the signed texts: the ipotesi of 5 July 2024 (scan, Federalberghi copy), the renewal of 18 January 2014 and the CCNL of 20 February 2010.
findings: 82 records verified. The salary periods cited the 2010 text: the 2016 values are in the 2014 renewal (p. 17), the 2024-2027 values in the 2024 ipotesi (p. 42). The 2024 text has no text layer: its quotes are OCR, checked on the page images.
Level B is quadro (art. 48 c.1), not impiegato; levels 1-7 have no category of their own (art. 50, by mansione): null.
Added the Quadri function allowance of art. 145: A 75.00, B 70.00 from January 2009.
Sickness: 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21 of the net daily pay, 180 days a calendar year (art. 228), not a flat 100%.
Accrual: hotels and campsites counted twenty-sixths before 2024 too (artt. 225, 277): the cumulated-fractions clause dropped.

Seniority from 1 May 1990 (art. 158 c.4); Fon.Te. from 29 November 1996 (art. 162), no longer from 2026; ruleset and validity from the decorrenza of 1 July 2024 (art. 199); the ruleset source is the 2024 ipotesi.
Holiday overtime 30% stays derived from art. 219 c.1: the CCNL sets no festive overtime rate.
Overtime is paid on the retribuzione of art. 148 divided by 172 (art. 151): hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances.

Production blocked: no signed copy of the accordo apprendistato of 17 April 2012 (base durations, art. 13) in the CNEL archive of H052 or at the signatories; only art. 14 bis is read in the 2014 renewal.
No renewal after the ipotesi of 5 July 2024 through October 2026.
sickness_net_basis is recorded on every run with a sickness event (trigger run), not only documented.

The apprenticeship durations without a signed source are now a limitation on every apprentice run (apprenticeship_durations_unsourced); with every remaining gap flagged on the runs it concerns, the file moves to production.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-01: the paga base nazionale of every level and tranche from July 2024, the extra months against the ipotesi of 5 July 2024, the scatti and the hourly divisor against the CCNL of 20 February 2010, and a year and a termination of a 4th level worker against a hand oracle.
findings: Art. 152 c. 1 as replaced in 2024 (p. 42, scan read by OCR): the 50 amounts of the ten levels from July 2024 to November 2027 match the file.

Art. 160 (p. 45): tredicesima of one monthly pay at Christmas; art. 161 (p. 46): quattordicesima of the pay in force on 30 June, paid with the July pay, in twelfths of the twelve months before 1 July. Match with the fourteen payments of the file.
Art. 158 c. 4 of the 2010 text (pp. 140-141): six scatti, A 40,80 to 7 30,47. Match. Hourly divisor 172 for a 40-hour week. Match.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios turismo-year and turismo-june): a 4th level impiegato hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 10 employees, across the tranche of May 2026; every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent.
